name: Le Meridien St. Louis Clayton
insider_take: This sophisticated Le Méridien outpost sits in Clayton's prestigious business district, where European elegance meets Midwest charm just minutes from Forest Park—one of America's largest urban parks.
whats_special: Le Méridien St. Louis Clayton occupies a prime spot in Clayton's "downtown," an upscale enclave that's home to Washington University's medical campus and some of the region's finest dining. The hotel's sleek design contrasts beautifully with Clayton's tree-lined streets and historic architecture, while Forest Park—larger than Central Park—lies just across the street with world-class museums, golf, and the renowned St. Louis Zoo.
pro_tip: Book a park-view room to wake up to Forest Park's 1,300 acres of green space. The hotel's location puts you within walking distance of the Saint Louis Art Museum and a quick MetroLink ride to downtown's Gateway Arch.
dont_miss: Stroll through Forest Park to visit the free Saint Louis Art Museum, catch a show at the outdoor Muny theater (America's oldest outdoor musical theater), or explore the Missouri History Museum. Clayton's Centene Plaza and the vibrant Delmar Loop are both easily accessible for shopping and nightlife.
pros: Sophisticated European-inspired design with curated art and culture programming
Prime Clayton location steps from upscale dining, boutique shops, and corporate offices
Refined dining and cocktail experiences highlighting locally inspired menus
Stylish, well-appointed guest rooms with premium bedding and modern amenities
Excellent service and attentive staff consistently praised by guests
cons: Suburban Clayton setting requires a short drive or rideshare to downtown St. Louis attractions
Premium positioning means higher nightly rates compared to nearby alternatives
